name: Plan 4 · Upper/Lower Lean-Gain Block

meta.author: Claude (AI) from docs/ai/athlete-context.md
meta.split: Upper A / Lower A / Upper B / Lower B
meta.goal: Add lean mass (SMM 30 → 31+ kg) while holding body fat at ≤ 17 %; fix posture weak links (hip flexors, thoracic spine, upper back).
rationale: Last scan (2026-08-28): 67.4 kg, 17.2 % BF, SMM 30.0 kg, visceral fat 58 cm², 'standard' body type. Fat has trended down 22.2 → 17.2 % over a year while muscle rose only +1.7 kg: time to bias toward muscle gain with real progressive overload.

Previous blocks (Oct 2025 – Jan 2026) were 3×10–20 machine work with 1-min rests and no load tracking. Stimulus is now familiar; this block moves compounds to 6–10 reps, longer rests, and double progression so every session has a measurable target.

Three corrective sheets from the coach target anterior pelvic tilt, tight hip flexors and limited thoracic extension / scapular control. They become a mandatory 8-min warm-up in every session instead of a separate list that gets skipped.
Upper-back and posterior-chain volume is raised (rows ≥ presses, RDL + hip thrust) because earlier plans were quad- and press-dominant and the posture issues call for it.
4 days/week upper/lower gives each muscle 2 hits per week with 12–16 hard sets, within the recovery budget of a sedentary desk job (coach note on NEAT applies: aim for 8k+ steps on off days).

guidelines: Warm-up: 5 min incline walk, then the corrective block, then 1–2 ramp-up sets on the first compound of the day (50 % / 75 % of working load).
Pick loads so the LAST rep of each set lands at the RIR shown. Log every working set (weight, reps, RIR). The app suggests the next load.
Double progression: when every set of an exercise reaches the top of its rep range at the target RIR, add the increment next session (upper 2.5 kg, lower 5 kg, dumbbells next pair).
Rest: 2–3 min on the first two compounds, 60–90 s on isolation. Rest is part of the prescription, do not rush it.
Full range of motion, controlled 2–3 s eccentric. No static stretching or long cardio before lifting.
Conditioning: 15–20 min incline walk after Lower days or on an off day. Keep it easy (can talk).
Nutrition anchor: ~2 400 kcal (maintenance +150–250), protein 130–145 g/day (≈ 2 g/kg), 3–4 L water. Re-scan body composition at week 5 and week 9.
If a station is busy, use the listed alternative, log it under the same exercise and note the swap.

weeks.label: Intro
weeks.instruction: Find working loads. RIR 3 on everything. No failure.

weeks.label: Accumulate
weeks.instruction: RIR 2. Add load where week 1 felt easy.

weeks.label: Accumulate
weeks.instruction: RIR 2. Chase the top of every rep range.

weeks.label: Accumulate
weeks.instruction: RIR 1–2. Last set of each compound may go to RIR 1.

weeks.label: Deload
weeks.instruction: Same loads, 60 % of sets (round down), RIR 3–4. Re-scan body composition this week.

weeks.label: Intensify
weeks.instruction: RIR 2. Resume progression from week 4 loads.

weeks.label: Peak
weeks.instruction: RIR 0–1 on the last set of isolation work, RIR 1 on compounds. Best effort week.

weeks.label: Deload + re-test
weeks.instruction: 60 % of sets at -10 % load, RIR 3–4. Re-scan, then generate the next block from this log.

sessions.name: Corrective warm-up (every session)
notes: Do this after 5 min of incline walking and before the first lift. Quality over speed; breathe out on every rep.

exercises.name: Dead bug with posterior pelvic tilt
exercises.cue: Flatten lower back into the floor before each leg lowers; exhale fully.

exercises.name: Glute bridge march
exercises.cue: Hips level, ribs down; squeeze glutes, not lower back.

exercises.name: Cat–cow + quadruped thoracic rotation
exercises.nameFa: گربه گاو + چرخش سینه‌ای چهار دست و پا
exercises.cue: Hand behind head, rotate elbow to ceiling, follow with the eyes.

exercises.name: Wall slide + lift-off
exercises.cue: Forearms on the wall, ribs down, slide up, lift hands 2 cm off at the top for 2 s.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch (PNF)
exercises.cue: Tuck pelvis, squeeze rear glute 5 s, relax deeper, repeat.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades pinned, feet driving, bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Lever high row (chest supported)
exercises.nameFa: اچ دستگاه / رو با تکیه سینه
exercises.cue: Pull elbows down and back, pause 1 s squeezing shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.cue: Ribs down, do not arch; press slightly forward of the ears.

exercises.name: Cable lat pulldown (full ROM)
exercises.cue: Lean back 15°, bar to upper chest, full stretch at the top.

blocks.note: Alternate the two, rest after the pair.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Lead with the elbow, stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to the ribs; control the lowering.

exercises.name: Cable rope pushdown
exercises.cue: Split the rope at the bottom, elbows still.

exercises.name: Hack squat (sled)
exercises.cue: Heels down, knees track over toes, full depth without the pelvis tucking.

exercises.name: Barbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Hips back, bar on the thighs, neutral spine; feel hamstrings, stop before the back rounds.

exercises.name: 45° leg press
exercises.cue: Feet mid-platform, lower until the hips start to lift, then stop.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Pad above the heels, lean slightly forward to stretch the hamstrings.

exercises.name: Lever standing calf raise
exercises.cue: 2 s pause at the bottom stretch, no bouncing.

exercises.name: Cable kneeling crunch
exercises.cue: Curl the spine, hips still, exhale hard at the bottom.

sessions.name: Upper B · Incline, pull-up & rear delts
sessions.nameFa: بالاتنه B · بالاسینه، بارفیکس و سرشانه پشتی

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell bench press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30°, elbows 45° from the torso, deep stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up (wide)
exercises.cue: Log the ASSISTANCE weight. When all sets hit 10 reps, reduce assistance by 5 kg next time. Chest to the bar, no kipping.

exercises.name: Cable seated row (neutral grip)
exercises.cue: Chest tall, elbows to the hips, 1 s squeeze, let the shoulder blades glide forward on the stretch.

exercises.name: Lever seated fly (pec deck)
exercises.cue: Slight elbow bend, squeeze 1 s, open until a mild chest stretch.

exercises.name: Cable rear-delt row with rope (face pull)
exercises.cue: Pull to the nose, thumbs back, elbows high; this is for posture, keep it strict.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.cue: Straight up, 1 s hold, no rolling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell incline biceps curl
exercises.nameFa: جلو بازو دمبل روی میز شیب‌دار
exercises.cue: Arms hang back, supinate at the top, slow lowering.

exercises.name: Cable overhead triceps extension (rope)
exercises.nameFa: پشت بازو سیمکش بالای سر با طناب
exercises.cue: Elbows by the ears, full stretch, lock out without flaring.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
exercises.cue: Rear foot on a bench, torso slightly forward, front heel heavy. Start with the weaker (left) leg.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust (back on bench)
exercises.cue: Chin tucked, ribs down, 2 s squeeze at the top; shins vertical at lockout.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: 1 s squeeze at the top, control down.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.cue: Hips pressed into the pad, no lifting the pelvis.

exercises.name: Seated hip abduction
exercises.cue: Lean forward slightly, 1 s hold at the widest point.

exercises.name: Lever seated calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch 2 s at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hanging knee raise
exercises.cue: Tilt the pelvis up at the top (curl, do not swing). Progress to straight legs.

sessions.name: Core menu · pick 1–2 at the end of an Upper day
sessions.nameFa: حرکات core پیشنهادی · یک یا دو حرکت انتخاب کنید
notes: 3 sets close to failure, 60 s rest. Rotate movements through the block.

exercises.name: Farmer's / suitcase carry
exercises.cue: Heavy, tall, ribs down. Suitcase (one hand) for obliques.

exercises.name: Hyperextension (45°)
exercises.cue: Glute-driven, stop at neutral, no hyper-arching.
